prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Seaborgium (Sg) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: the cushioned foredeck of a moored yacht
Time of day: night under neon and signage light, coloured reflections.
Hair: her hair let down loose over her shoulders — same colour and length as the attached image.
Small moment: her wet fringe clings to her forehead in loose strands.
Outfit: a qipao-inspired silk set with a mandarin collar and frog-button closures — in soft dove grey; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body facing the camera; camera slightly above, looking down at her.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right index finger rests against her lips in a hush.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: relaxed brow, softly open eyes, lips closed and unstrained, no smile.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — seaborgium: a heavy synthetic metal below chromium, molybdenum and tungsten, first made in 1974 at a hillside laboratory by striking californium with oxygen ions, and the first element named after a person still living: a chemist from a northern mining town who helped find ten elements and, against warnings that it would ruin his name, redrew the periodic table by adding a whole new row of fourteen elements beneath it; a tireless diarist and long-distance walker, whose mailing address could be written in element symbols alone — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: petite and compact yet curvaceous — full bust and rounded hips on a small frame — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
